acceptance: A failing ls-remote yields failed, not not-present (red first)
Both tests assert behaviour without touching the real repo
fix: Report lookup failures as failed, run gh in RepoRoot, and make both tests assert their claims hermetically.
source: console, 2026-09-30, comment round 12 editors and reviewers (PR #749)
summary: deleteRemoteTagWith ignores the ls-remote error, so a network failure or a missing origin reads as not-present and counts as success; any gh release view failure also reads as not-present, and defaultGhDeleteRelease runs gh in the process cwd, not RepoRoot. TestAppendLedger_MkdirFailure_ReturnsError calls err.Error() after a non-fatal nil check and ends in an empty if; TestRun_NilSteps_FallbacksAssigned forks the real gh/git against the cwd repo and asserts nothing.
title: rollback reads a network or auth failure as not-present (success), and two of its tests are vacuous
